messages.subject: Ardent AR-6.0 firmware 3.2 — 550 V DC limit
messages.bodyPreview: Reminder following Ardent notice ARN-2026-08: all AR-6.0 units shipped since July run firmware 3.2 with a 550 V maximum DC input. Your catalogue was updated in August.
